'''Horob''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Vardoss sector/Legends|Vardoss sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] maintained a research laboratory on Horob. There, the Alliance developed a sophisticated sensor chip, but could produce only an experimental version before the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Evacuation of Horob|discovered]] the base.
